findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0326: References to APIs Allowing Fallback to Non-Biometric Authentication
findings.explanation:
BiometricDeviceAuthentication allows DEVICE_CREDENTIAL fallback alongside biometrics (ALLOWED_AUTHENTICATORS). Whether that is acceptable for the app-lock feature is a product decision.
app/src/main/java/org/thoughtcrime/securesms/BiometricDeviceAuthentication.kt:29: Allowed authenticators include DEVICE_CREDENTIAL.
